title.rendered: 2027: Ex-lawmaker hails Tinubu’s renomination of Shettima as running mate

content.rendered:
The Director-General of the Border Communities Development Agency, Abdulrazak Namdas, has congratulated Vice President Kashim Shettima on his renomination as the All Progressives Congress vice-presidential candidate for the 2027 general election, describing President Bola Tinubu’s decision as a demonstration of confidence in competence, loyalty and continuity in governance.

Namdas, a former member of the House of Representatives and spokesman for the 8th Assembly, said the decision to retain Shettima underscores the administration’s commitment to stability and teamwork as it seeks a second term in office.

In a statement issued on Sunday in Abuja, the DG also commended Tinubu for what he described as the foresight in retaining a deputy who has played an active role in the administration since it assumed office in May 2023.

“As a proud member of the APC and a stakeholder committed to the unity and progress of our nation, I heartily congratulate His Excellency, Senator Kashim Shettima, GCON, on this well-deserved renomination.

“I also extend my profound gratitude to President Bola Tinubu, GCFR, for the wisdom and foresight demonstrated in retaining a Vice President who has stood firm with him in steering the affairs of this country through challenging times,” he stated.

Namdas said the Tinubu-Shettima administration had provided purposeful leadership through the implementation of the Renewed Hope Agenda, arguing that the Vice President has remained actively involved in governance rather than playing a ceremonial role.

“Since assuming office in 2023, the Tinubu-Shettima ticket has provided purposeful leadership anchored on the Renewed Hope Agenda. Senator Shettima has not been a spare tyre. He has been an active partner in governance. From driving economic reforms, to deepening engagement with the private sector, to representing Nigeria with dignity on the global stage, and to providing calm, thoughtful leadership in the North East and across the country, he has shown capacity, humility, and dedication,” he added.

According to Namdas, Tinubu’s decision sends a positive signal about the administration’s preference for consistency and experience in leadership.

“Mr President’s choice to retain Senator Shettima sends a clear message to Nigerians and to the world: that this administration values continuity, experience, and teamwork. It tells our citizens that performance will be rewarded, and that the job of nation-building is not for grandstanding, but for steady hands,” he stated.

The BCDA boss also expressed confidence in the APC’s chances in the 2027 presidential election, describing the Tinubu-Shettima ticket as the party’s strongest electoral offering.

“I also congratulate our great party, the APC, for presenting what is, without doubt, the most formidable presidential ticket ahead of the 2027 general election. With President Tinubu at the helm and Senator Shettima as his deputy, the APC is offering Nigerians a tested team that understands the assignment and has the courage to take the hard decisions required to reposition our economy, secure every part of Nigeria, and create opportunities for our young people.

“The road ahead will demand more sacrifice, more unity, and more belief in the Nigeria project. But with this ticket, I am confident that the APC will not only retain power in 2027 but will do so with an even stronger mandate because Nigerians can see that the foundation being laid today will deliver the prosperity we all seek tomorrow.

“Once again, congratulations to Senator Kashim Shettima. Thank you, Mr President, for your confidence and for putting Nigeria first. And congratulations to the APC family. The work continues, and victory, by the grace of God and the will of the people, is assured,” the statement further read.

Namdas, who was recently appointed Director-General of the Border Communities Development Agency, has been a prominent figure in the APC and has served in various public offices, including as a member of the House of Representatives representing Jada, Ganye, Mayo-Belwa and Toungo Federal Constituency of Adamawa State.
